name: manual_c6f5aa
claim: With parallel read-only analysts, give each a distinct lens and brief it fully, then let ONE writer apply every edit sequentially; analysts diversify findings, and a single writer means shared files are never written concurrently and no merge conflicts arise.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: three analysts (concurrency, liveness, efficiency) plus inlined-diff agy passes fed one writer; their findings overlapped usefully and no file was written twice at once.

rationale: 2026-10-19: three analysts (concurrency, liveness, efficiency) plus inlined-diff agy passes fed one writer; their findings overlapped usefully and no file was written twice at once.
